profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software engineer with a focus in back-end Java in web technologies, some experience with front-end, and familiar with server configuration. Interested in Java based software development and lead roles.

Technologies:
Java, SQL, J2EE, JSP, Jersey RESTful services, GIT, Bamboo, Bitbucket, SVN, Tomcat, Weblogic, Apache Web Server, Oracle database, Jenkins, PostgreSQL, MySQL, JBOSS

positions.title: Business Platform Lead/Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop new features and bug fixes for Java and JSP based web application.
•	Work closely with Chief Development Officer on task and priority management for team of 9 engineers.
•	Implement Single Sign On (SSO) using Shibboleth Service Provider and integrate with 2 Identity Providers. Develop RESTful service to allow SSO partners to create user accounts.
•	Develop new user interface using YUI, JSON, HTML, and CSS for new and existing web content. Develop Java servlet to provide data to user interface in JSON format.
•	Migrate application server from Weblogic to Tomcat in test and production environments. Determine Apache to Tomcat configuration and set up load balancing. Work closely with system admin to ensure smooth operation of servers.

positions.title: Software Engineer Senior
positions.description:
Lead role in the development of several software components with junior team members.
Liaison with the customer and contractors for UFS.
Develop web 2.0 gadgets for the Navy to manage their resources using GWT, JavaScript, and restful web services. Install web service security.
Support integration and testing activities with other Lockheed Martin and external stakeholders; Debug and provide fixes for problems that arose during integration and testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed a C++/C test driver to communicate with hardware.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed user interface for IronClad product using Qt and C++ and utilizing the IronKey API.

positions.title: Chief Architect and Deputy Software Lead for Engineering Leadership Development Program Project
positions.description:
Designed system architecture using MVC and ensured system design met customer requirements.
Responsible for assignment of tasks to 6 software developers using the Agile methodology and enforced project deliverable deadlines were met.
Developed and debugged C++/C data parsing software converting input files into MySQL; Installed and used Connector/C++ for the database connectivity.
Developed Java 3D GUI using the NASA World Wind API.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Java configuration interface to Cisco and Juniper routers; Configured Cisco and Juniper routers through both CLI and custom interface.
Led execution of network tests, including triggering router events and collecting data with Wireshark and other programs for analysis. 
Developed Java web service software that interfaced with an IPv6-based PostgreSQL.
Designed and implemented a network data model utilizing Hibernate. 
Developed Python scripts automating deployment of new software releases, significantly reducing deployment time; Scripts both installed and configured software for an IPv6 network. 
Validated releases of software and performed end-to-end testing in an IPv6 environment. 
Debugged and contributed to solutions and determination of root causes for installation/integration issues. 
Supported various TPN team tasks, including leading and coordinating network test case runs and scripting for network experiments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Integrated Opnet network model with an external component for the TSAT Prototype Network team. 
Configured a small network of both physical and simulated IPv4/IPv6 Linux boxes and routers to run ping/ping6 tests for the evaluation of the System-In-The-Loop and IPv6 features; Debugged traffic issues by analyzing the traffic flow through the protocols of the router in the model.
Integrated external software and Opnet model C++/C code to evaluate the Co-Simulation feature.

positions.title: Software Engineer for Internal Research & Development
positions.description:
Created a data model of 3 satellite systems for internal research and development; Translated the data model to WSDLs and XSDs for the web services. 
Developed web services for several components of the system using Java and XMLBeans.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed the GUI for an internal testing tool.
Created a script to automate the SLOC count of the team's code.

positions.title: Extreme Blue Speed Team Intern
positions.description:
Prototyped new server technologies to enable web based forms applications.
Managed technical development of a 5-person team-owned project.
Prepared and presented technical proposals to executives.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked with a team of software engineers in software development, problem resolution and analysis
Developed a tool to parse recording files and store data into database.
